title: Yellow Citrusy Dutch Cheese Lasagna
description: A post-workout Dutch dish featuring a citrusy twist and a cheesy pull, made with desiccated coconut and low-glycemic ingredients. This dish is perfect for a satisfying dinner after a long day.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the desiccated coconut, Dutch cheese, lemon juice, orange zest, eggs, cottage cheese, salt, and black pepper.
In a large baking dish, create a thin layer of the cheese mixture.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the cheese layer.
Fold the noodles over the cheese mixture to create a tight layer.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Bake the lasagna in the preheated oven for 35 minutes.
Let the lasagna rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
